description: Task 1 schema: ATC structured understanding. Defines action types, entity slots, and consequence weights used by AR-Geo/AR-Lin evaluation.

altitude_control.description: Climb, descend, or maintain altitude/flight level

clearance.description: Authorization to proceed, land, take off, or approach

heading_control.description: Heading, turn, or directional control instruction

runway_instruction.description: Hold short, line up, take off, or land instruction

contact.description: Instruction to contact a controller or frequency

waypoint.description: Navigation point, route point, or navaid

condition.description: Condition, restriction, advisory, or operational context

traffic.description: Third-party aircraft referenced but not directly addressed

notes: Weights encode relative operational criticality, not accident probability.
AR-Geo uses geometric aggregation over slots per action; a single missing critical slot (weight >= 0.8) substantially lowers the score.
action_type labels in tokens[] use the same keys as utterance_action, marking the span that triggers the action.
All token spans must be continuous, non-overlapping, and cover the full utterance.
